Buy-to-let profitability

For individuals considering a rental property (unfurnished, furnished, flat-share or short-term let). Up to 5 properties side by side: total purchase cost (notary fees entered or estimated, assumption shown), rents per unit or per night, vacancy in months per year, owner's costs, your loan; gross and net yield, monthly cash flow before tax, monthly savings effort, maximum price for a target yield, stress tests (rent −10%, one more vacant month, rate +1 point) and a printable analysis sheet. No market rates, price per m² or reference rents built in; tax is not calculated.
